newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate leader says capital gains tax cut key.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate leader says capital gains tax cut key.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Tuesday Republicans were placing a lot of significance on a capital gains tax cut and that it was an area he believed on which agreement could be reached.
"It's important in our budget that we have some tax provisions that would make the tax code fairer, like the $500 tax credit and some modifications in the estate tax," Lott, R-Miss., told reporters.

"But we also think it's important we have something in there that will encourage growth -- capital gains tax rate cut -- we still place a lot of significance on that, the president has talked more about it, we think that's an area where we're going to be able to come to an agreement," Lott said.
